accepted_scope: Per-layer sums, four-factor identity and two-factor reported product close on existing RESULT without rerunning any consumer.
Factors are descriptive multiplicative scales, not causal contribution percentages; methods have different E and hidden trajectories.

T/U is not a redundancy score; J/I is not pure orientation. R/J only compares actual input joint coupling against its independent-moment reference, not all forms of cancellation or low-sensitivity directions.

PAS rank128 energy router gives general denominator128*tau with two active experts. Stage-start tau1.5 is not measured final tau. Complete object loading preserves Python module attributes; no checkpoint/model was read during this review.
Historical80 TRAIN/answer positions/168 projections/1pct two models only; no 10pct functional generality or F1 inference. Formal PAS-static uses a distinct c55 calibration.

Primary literature descriptions correctly separate MC-SMoE frequency/similarity/compression, PAS cross-checkpoint JS, and SMoLoRA expert-count saturation from this measured condition-function residual.
